extracted.name: Dill Cucumber Dip
extracted.description: This dill cucumber dip recipe makes a creamy, cool, zesty, and refreshing dip that’s perfect for garden-grown cucumbers. Serve with crackers or chips.
instruction_lines: Place cream cheese in a medium bowl; beat until smooth. Stir in cucumbers, mayonnaise, lemon juice, dill, and hot pepper sauce.
